description: A fill companion node that fills each area with a random color

inputs.description: The input fill data, to be connected to the output of a Fill node
inputs.name: in

name: Fill to Random Color

outputs.expr: mix($edgecolor.rgb, rand3_4d(vec4($(name_uv)_bb.xy, $(name_uv)_bb.z + float($seed), $(name_uv)_bb.w)), step(0.0000001, dot($(name_uv)_bb.zw, vec2(1.0))))
outputs.label: Output
